name: Festive Recipes
label: Quest
description: Festive Recipes: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Progress
paras: The dresses and pant suits you see are traditional clothes from many years past. They are worn in honor of old ways and loved ones gone.
If you bring me coins of ancestry, friend, then I will give you the pattern to create traditional red dresses or suits.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Here are the patterns, friend. I am sure you will find the product of this knowledge quite beautiful.
